description: Defines a PolicyTrie class implementing a trie data structure for policy enforcement, including methods for building, traversing, and manipulating policy-related data structures, with focus on resource keys, permissions, and JSON views.

classes.name: PolicyTrie
classes.description: A trie data structure for policy enforcement, mapping resource keys to grant/revoke indices, with methods for building, traversing, and generating JSON views.

methods.name: fromPolicy
methods.description: Interprets a collection of PolicyEntry objects as a trie for policy enforcement.

methods.name: getJsonKeyIterator
methods.description: Converts a ResourceKey into an iterator of JsonKey objects representing the resource path.

methods.name: seekOrCreate
methods.description: Finds or creates a trie node matching a given resource path.

methods.name: computeForChild
methods.description: Computes or retrieves a child node for the next path segment.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Wrapper for Map.compute to update or create child nodes.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Adds granted permissions for specified subjects at this node.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Adds revoked permissions for specified subjects at this node.

methods.name: getGrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Returns the grant/revoke index at this node.

methods.name: getTransitiveClosure
methods.description: Returns a copy of the trie with grants and revokes inherited from ancestors.

methods.name: computeTransitiveClosure
methods.description: Helper method to compute transitive closure recursively.

methods.name: getBottomUpGrantTrie
methods.description: Returns a trie with grants accumulated from descendants.

methods.name: getBottomUpRevokeTrie
methods.description: Returns a trie with revokes accumulated from descendants.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if a child node exists for a given key.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON object view of the data based on permissions and subject IDs.

methods.name: getViewForJsonFieldOrNull
methods.description: Gets a JSON view for a specific JSON field if permitted.

methods.name: getViewForJsonValueOrNull
methods.description: Gets a JSON view for a JSON value if permitted.

methods.name: getViewForJsonObjectOrNull
methods.description: Gets a JSON view for a JSON object if permitted.

methods.name: filterCandidate
methods.description: Filters a JSON candidate based on permissions.

methods.name: getViewForJsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Gets a JSON view for a JSON array if permitted.

methods.name: seekToLeastAncestor
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor node matching the path.

methods.name: seekToExactNode
methods.description: Finds the node matching the path exactly.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Traverses the trie along a path, applying functions at end conditions.
